article.title: Amazon推出Shop Direct商戶入口，合資格店舖可提交商品目錄
article.title_en: Amazon opens Shop Direct workspace for eligible merchants’ product feeds
article.summary: 新工作台讓合資格商戶提交商品資料，商品有機會在Amazon搜尋及Alexa for Shopping出現。
article.summary_en: Eligible merchants can submit feeds for possible discovery in Amazon search and Alexa for Shopping.
highlights: 商戶可重用已為其他購物平台準備的商品目錄。
工作台列出已啟用的商品，商戶仍自行管理庫存、定價與履約。
highlights_en: Merchants can reuse catalogs prepared for other shopping destinations.
The workspace shows active items. Merchants still handle stock, pricing and fulfillment.
article.why: 品牌可把Amazon視為自家網店的另一個商品發現入口。
article.why_en: Amazon can become another product discovery entry point for a brand’s own store.
article.next_step: 先核對參與資格，以少量在售商品檢查價格、庫存與落地頁資料。
article.next_step_en: Check eligibility and validate prices, inventory and landing pages with a small assortment.
article.detail: Shop Direct原有的購物流程繼續運作，新推出的是商戶自助管理入口。一般導流會把顧客帶回商戶網站，合資格商品也可能經Amazon的代購工具完成購買。品牌可先挑選庫存穩定及資料齊備的商品接入，並在自己的分析工具分開觀察導流、結帳及訂單，以便評估這個入口。
article.detail_en: Shop Direct already existed. The new workspace lets merchants manage participation themselves. The standard flow sends shoppers to the merchant’s site, while some items qualify for Buy for Me. Track referrals, checkout and orders separately to assess the new entry point.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
